payload.summary: The amendments the political groups put to Budget Council on 24 February 2026. The Labour group added £313,000 of items to the main motion — fly-tipping and graffiti enforcement, communal-area improvements, community clean-ups and political assistant provision — funded from the 2026/27 contingency. The Green and Liberal Democrat groups tabled a £65,000 ward-level community cohesion fund, and the Green group £45,000 for tree planting at a stated £459 per tree.
